title: Synthetic organic tanning substances; inorganic tanning substances; tanning preparations; enzymatic preparations for pre-tanning

review.classification: Official 34330 includes inorganic tanning substances. Documentary evidence supports a specific basic chromium sulfate powder supplied as a tanning agent, with different functions from 34240 generic salts, 34320 botanical tanning extracts and 34340 colour preparations.
review.primary_evidence: Chrompik’s producer specification establishes a green dry tanning powder and distinguishes two basicity grades and alternative packages. PE-lined multiwall paper bags are one actual commercial configuration. ATSDR and the historical CN1099727A support the selected industrial route qualitatively. IS 6301:1971 concerns basic chromium sulfate for tanning. Its analytical basicity evidence does not demonstrate current compliance, lot-specific grade or species in an untreated sample. Distinguish the product test from effluent and stack analyses.
review.measurement: P is net first accepted factory-gate delivery, while R describes production release. Track actual returns, WIP/FG movements and the corresponding per-exchange burden vectors so shipments and new production are not interchanged. Powder contains its retained sodium sulfate; do not treat this constituent as a second co-product. Resolve the actual component packaging movements and allocate burdens to the cohort once. Total chromium, trivalent/hexavalent analyses and the limits of detection are separate evidence.
review.readiness: The corrected candidate contains matched bilingual atomic exchanges, physically supported reference measurement and explicit open identities for the actual powder and site exchanges. Actual composition, transfer quantities, utility sources and medium-specific speciation remain sampling and data requirements. Scientific review and formal translation review remain pending.
review.original_native_records: Fixed public XML confirms the Mass to Units of mass to kg chain. The Technical Energy property points to version 01.00.000 of the energy group, while the archived group inspected is version 03.00.003. Metered MJ/kWh is independent of a specific supplier or its reference property. No site-specific product identity is inferred from either unit chain.

sources.role: Manufacturer’s dry chrome tanning agent grade and alternative packages.
ATSDR, Toxicological Profile for Chromium, chapter 5: historical commercial route context.
Historical primary industrial process description; qualitative route only.
Indian Standard 6301:1971, historical product-specific basicity determination.
ASTM’s publisher scope confirms the separate roles of chromium and acidity analysis in calculation of basicity for tanning liquors. Do not transfer this scope to stack/effluent speciation.
